«Самоотречение» (samootrechenie) is 'self-renunciation'. Lamennais's «на сей час» (na sei chas, 'for this hour') is kept as 'for this hour' each time, so that his echo of Christ's words stays visible, and «крестная смерть» (krestnaya smert') is 'the death on the cross', not 'the crucifixion'.
Source observation: [6] «на сеи земле» ('on this earth'): «сеи» is evidently a misprint for «сей» (sei, 'this'). Translated as 'this'.
